entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: A Skyshroud Elf and later Zombie Phyrexian cyborg built from the body of the elven princess Avila; protagonist of the Nemesis novel, created to choose the new Evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Avila
entities.description: An elven princess of the Skyshroud forest and daughter of Eladamri who was poisoned; her body was rebuilt as Belbe.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Avila's father, an elf who is captured while trying to destroy Predator and escapes to Dominaria with Belbe's help before poisoning her.

entities.name: Abcal-dro
entities.description: A member of Yawgmoth's Inner Circle who rebuilt Avila's body and gave Belbe her name and function.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler who wanted to observe the selection of the next Evincar through Belbe.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane where Belbe lived.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane to which Avila's body was taken and where Belbe was built.

entities.name: Eye of Yawgmoth
entities.description: A black sphere implanted in Belbe so Yawgmoth could observe; she disabled it.

entities.name: Evincar of Rath
entities.description: The ruler of Rath that Belbe was to choose or become.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The former Evincar presumed dead in Mercadia who returns and is executed at the time of Belbe's funeral.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A candidate for evincar who controls flowstone, is hostile to Belbe, and forces her to crown him.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A candidate for evincar who commanded the Phyrexian armies and the skyship Predator.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A captive abandoned during the Weatherlight's exodus who becomes Belbe's lover and later a twisted four-armed figure.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Greven's skyship, which Eladamri sought to destroy.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: The Phyrexian base on Rath where Belbe restores order.

entities.name: Flowstone
entities.description: The substance Crovax and Ertai can control and whose production leads to the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The overlaying of Rath onto Dominaria that Belbe set a plan in motion to prevent.

entities.name: Dream Halls
entities.description: The place where Eladamri and a band of rebels were trapped.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: A rebel who escapes to Dominaria with Eladamri.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: A rebel who escapes to Dominaria with Eladamri.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane to which Eladamri's group escapes.

events.summary: Avila's former lover, turned into a Phyrexian agent, poisons her and delivers her body to Phyrexia.
events.quote: He poisoned Avila despite his love for her

events.summary: In Phyrexia, Abcal-dro reconstructs Avila's body as a cyborg, names her Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth.
events.quote: A black sphere was then implanted in her body

events.summary: Belbe restores order at the Stronghold and shortlists Crovax, Greven il-Vec and Ertai as evincar, preferring Ertai.
events.quote: Ertai made the best impression on her

events.summary: Belbe grows disillusioned with Phyrexia, disables the Eye of Yawgmoth, and falls in love with Ertai.
events.quote: She disabled the Eye of Yawgmoth implanted in her

events.summary: Belbe begins a plan to cut flowstone production to prevent the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: she also set in motion a plan to decrease flowstone production at the Stronghold

events.summary: Crovax attacks Belbe, who defends herself.
events.quote: Crovax attacked her, but Belbe was able to defend herself

events.summary: Captured Eladamri attacks Belbe in rage on seeing his daughter's corpse reanimated; Belbe has him imprisoned and interrogated.
events.quote: Eladamri lashed out at her in rage

events.summary: Crovax organizes a coup and Belbe is forced to crown him evincar after a showdown with Ertai and the returning Volrath.
events.quote: Crovax organized a coup d'état to force her to declare him evincar

events.summary: At the Dream Halls Belbe learns her origins and reprograms her portal so Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Lin Sivvi escape to Dominaria.
events.quote: she reprogrammed her return portal to Phyrexia to allow Eladamri to escape to Dominaria

events.summary: Eladamri throws the last of Avila's poison on Belbe, killing her instantly.
events.quote: It was too potent even for Belbe's Phyrexian enhancements and she died instantly.

events.summary: Crovax holds a funeral for Belbe at Volrath's execution, and a twisted four-armed Ertai takes her skull from the pyre.
events.quote: a twisted, four-armed Ertai reached into the smoldering pyre and secreted away Belbe's skull
